### State Street Recognized By Euromoney Awards


10/16/2026


Download this Press Release (opens in new window)


**BOSTON, October 16, 2026** – State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced that it has been recognized with eight industry awards from Euromoney’s prestigious 2026 FX awards as well as the inaugural Euromoney Markets awards, a new program established to recognize excellence across capital markets, trading services and market infrastructure.


State Street Markets was named the winner in the following Euromoney FX categories:


-


World’s Best Bank for Real Money Clients


-


World's Best Bank for FX Research


-


World's Best FX Venue for Real Money (FX Connect®)


-


World's Best Provider of TCA Solutions (BestX®)


-


World's Best FX Solution for Real Money Clients (LINK)


State Street Markets was named the winner in the following Euromoney Markets categories:


-


World's Best Client Execution Service


-


World's Best Sales and Trading Team


-


World's Best TCA/Performance Analytics Provider (BestX®)


"We are honored to be recognized by Euromoney across our Markets franchise. These awards reflect the breadth of our capabilities, the strength of our client relationships, and the dedication of our teams around the world,” said Tony Bisegna, executive vice president and head of State Street Markets. “Our focus has always been on partnering with clients to solve challenges through innovative solutions, deep market expertise, and seamless execution. As client needs and markets continue to evolve, we remain committed to investing in our platform, advancing our product capabilities, and driving the next generation of innovation across the franchise."


"The inaugural Euromoney Markets Awards recognize excellence across capital markets, trading services and market infrastructure, making this recognition particularly meaningful for our business," said Dagmar Kamber Borens, executive vice president and head of State Street Markets EMEA. "Together with our success in this year's Euromoney FX Awards, these recognitions reflect the depth of our expertise across execution, analytics, research and trading solutions, as well as the strength of the platform we have built to support clients in today's market environment."


Learn more about[State Street Markets](https://www.statestreet.com/us/en/solutions/markets) .


**About State Street Corporation**


State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $59.2 trillion in assets under custody and/or administration and $6.3 trillion* in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, State Street operates globally in more than 100 geographic markets and employs approximately 51,000 worldwide. For more information, visit State Street's website at www.statestreet.com.


** Assets under management as of September 30, 2026 includes approximately $172 billion of assets with respect to SPDR® products for which State Street Global Advisors Funds Distributors, LLC (SSGA FD) acts solely as the marketing agent. SSGA FD and State Street Investment Management are affiliated.*
